section-heading.purpose: Caps heading under a 2px ink rule.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action on a screen, e.g. Start daily check-in.
components.css: .ds-btn { background: #0b4f9c; color: #fff; border: 2px solid #0b4f9c; border-radius: 0; height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; font: 700 16px 'Public Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-btn:hover { background: #083d7a; border-color: #083d7a; }

components.name: Warning Block
components.description: Most urgent Act alert, leads the page.
components.html:
WARNING
Fever with fast heart rate. Act on board now.
components.css: .ds-block { border: 2px solid #b3261e; background: #fff; font-family: 'Public Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-block-head { background: #b3261e; color: #fff; text-align: center; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .18em; font-size: 14px; padding: 4px; } .ds-block-body { padding: 20px 24px; color: #101318; }

components.name: Status Mark
components.description: Shape + word + colour, never colour alone.

narrative.overview: Every screen is one white procedure sheet on a grey binder ground: rules, tables, numbered steps and standard WARNING / CAUTION blocks instead of cards. The most urgent alert leads; the Can-this-wait-for-Earth timing table is the signature.

rules.name: The status-only rule
rules.body: Red, amber and green appear only in status marks, WARNING / CAUTION blocks and the safe-wait bar.

rules.name: Rules, not boxes
rules.body: Sections are separated by 2px ink rules; nothing floats in a rounded card.

dos: Lead with the most urgent block
Pair colour with shape and word
donts: No cards, rounded corners, gradients or glows
No label above the page title
